items.description:
OAB Chartered Accountants is a Centurion-based accounting practice serving small and medium-sized businesses in Pretoria and beyond. The firm describes itself as pairing the resources of a national firm with the personalised, value-based service of a local practice, aiming to support client growth through accounting, audit, tax, payroll and consulting work tailored to each business's needs. Its stated service range covers bookkeeping and accounting, the preparation of financial statements, payroll management, registrations and taxation, alongside assurance, compliance and trust accounting.

The firm draws on more than 25 years of experience and says its goal is to help businesses stay compliant while operating efficiently, with a stated vision of becoming a leading provider of trusted accounting solutions for businesses across the country.

Omega Risk Solutions is a pan-African security firm providing integrated protection services built around manned guarding, security monitoring and response, screening and executive protection. Its specialist risk services extend into occupational and environmental safety work, including fire risk management, alongside structured security training for its own officers. The firm positions its guarding teams as multiskilled, selected for their suitability to a given site as well as their integrity, and trained to handle access and egress control, searching, reception duties, key control, ID and biometric checks, patrols and escort work.

The company serves businesses and organisations across Africa, operating from both a Gauteng base in Rosslyn, Akasia, and a Pretoria head office in Arcadia. Its officers are selected not only for their suitability to a given assignment but for a genuine commitment to a career in the security risk-management field, giving clients continuity in the teams protecting their sites.

On The Dot is a South African media supply chain management company that distributes magazines, newspapers, subscriptions, community newspapers, pamphlets, parcels and FMCG products. It moves these goods through direct-to-store delivery, home delivery and informal networks.

The business was previously a business unit within the Media24 group, which is owned by Naspers, and is now owned by the Novus Holdings Group. Its logistics division offers business-to-business and business-to-consumer last-mile solutions for e-commerce and consumer products, as well as in-store merchandising. The company describes its mission as providing sustainable distribution solutions for media products while growing opportunities through specialised logistics, as the print media market continues to contract.

items.description:
Optilog Support Services CC offers asset management, logistics and engineering services built around proven products and turn-key business solutions. Its stated offering spans logistics and engineering services, asset verification, asset management and reliability-improvement training, and reliability engineering with decision-support software and services. The company describes a pragmatic approach to supporting operational and production systems, aiming for sustainable results from the start of a project.

Optilog works in both commercial and defence-related environments, and says its asset management and decision-support software is backed by staff who are available for technical support and customisation. The company's stated aim is to provide the right service, on time, every time, in support of assets and product systems.

Optimum Financial Services Group is an independent financial services provider offering holistic financial planning to individuals, families and businesses. Its personal services include life insurance, medical aid advice, investments, fiduciary services, short-term insurance and tax consulting. Its commercial services include life and risk cover, commercial insurance, drone insurance, employee benefits and payroll administration.

The group describes its purpose as developing and protecting clients' wealth through transparent, unbiased advice on life insurance, short-term insurance, medical insurance, investment planning, employee benefits and legal services. It says its mission is to ensure peace of mind through wealth creation, protection and growth, with the aim of empowering clients to make sound financial decisions.

items.description:
Outdoor Warehouse Zambezi trades from the Montana Value Centre in Pretoria, using a warehouse-style approach to create a one-destination store with a wide, quality range for local outdoor enthusiasts. Within that layout the store has striking interior design, specialist stations for more technical products, attractive change rooms, and a plan designed to be easy to navigate.

The Outdoor Warehouse chain dates back to the late 1990s, when various outdoor and sports outlets were consolidated into a dedicated chain of outdoor stores within the Moresport Group, which also owns Sportsmans Warehouse. The business focuses on camping, hiking, off-road and general open-air recreation, catering to the outdoor pursuits South Africans enjoy.

items.description:
Paint Kingdom is a painting contractor founded almost a decade ago that has built a reputation for high-quality finishes across Pretoria and the wider Gauteng region. The company set out to elevate painting standards for residential, commercial and new development projects, and says it remains committed to consistent results on every job. Its stated core values are quality and craftsmanship, meaning superior finishes with meticulous attention to detail; customer satisfaction, through prioritising client needs; and professionalism and integrity, with honest and transparent dealings.

The business operates from Monavoni in Centurion and describes close to ten years of painting experience across residential, commercial and new-build work.

Palladium Hair Company is part of a hair and beauty brand founded in 1997, with salons in Pretoria and Cape Town. Its services are organised for three client groups. Palladium Women covers cuts, colour, hair transformations, maintenance and extensions, and a professional range of hair-care products is sold in salon. Palladium Men offers classic and trend-driven looks from barbers and colour stylists who shape each cut to the client's head. Palladium Kids provides quick, considered children's cuts in a calm, caring space.

The brand says every service is guided by conscious craft, using sustainably sourced products, water-saving practices and eco-minded techniques.

Parts Incorporated Africa (PIA) is a division of the Motus Aftermarket Parts Group, which trades in the replacement automotive parts industry. It markets and distributes automotive parts and components for do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and leisure travel customers, and distributes all leading original equipment brands as genuine replacement parts. The group owns well-known aftermarket brands including Midas, Alert Engine Parts, Beekman, Rhinoman, Motolek, Auto Care and Diagnostics, ADCO diesel fuel injection specialists, Clutch and Brake Specialists, and Ferobrake.

Its sustainability initiatives aim to reduce the environmental impact of its activities, alongside socio-economic development programmes across South Africa. Motus Aftermarket Parts is a division of Motus Corporation, a diversified, non-manufacturing automotive business with a presence in South Africa and selected international markets.

Petzone Lynnwood Lane is a pet supply retailer stocking food, bedding and toys for dogs, cats, fish, birds and small pets, alongside a broad range of general pet accessories. Shopping is done in-store, with card and NFC payment accepted at the till, and the store has wheelchair-accessible facilities for customers who need them.

The branch trades from the Lynnwood Lane Retail Centre on The Highway in Equestria, Pretoria, and has built up a 4.3 rating from 98 reviews on its current listing. For pet owners in the area, it offers a nearby source of everyday pet food and supplies as well as bedding, toys and accessories for a range of animals.

City Medical, listed as Pharmachem House, is a pharmaceutical wholesaler that describes its mission as becoming the wholesaler of choice for customers across South Africa. It aims to deliver quality, cost-effective pharmaceutical and related products alongside a high level of service. The group traces its origins back about 30 years to modest beginnings and says it has grown into the largest privately owned pharmaceutical wholesaler in South Africa, with four distribution centres in Pretoria, Durban, Polokwane and Johannesburg.

City Medical states that it acts with integrity and transparency, is fair and honest in its dealings, and provides personalised customer care. Its vision rests on three strategic pillars: innovation, culture and sustainable growth. The company also says it aims to ensure price competitiveness on the products it supplies.

Pii Digital is a South African digital agency founded in 2008 and based in Pretoria, with offices in Johannesburg, Durban and Cape Town. It covers five service areas: design and development of websites, apps and custom software; AI services, including voice and chatbot agents, answer-engine optimisation and AI-driven video; digital marketing, including SEO, paid media, content and PR; multimedia production, including photography, video, drone and streaming work; and branding. The agency is B-BBEE Level 1 certified. Organisations it lists among its clients include the IDC, SANParks, NERSA, Parliament, Coca-Cola, McDonald's and BMW Motorrad.

Pii Digital presents itself as a single team able to handle a brand's website, advertising, AI projects and brand refresh, rather than leaving the client to coordinate several separate vendors.

Pineapple Cosmetics is a South African beauty brand offering a makeup and skincare range built around bromelain, a pineapple-derived enzyme, and positioned as halal-certified, paraben-free and cruelty-free. Its makeup line spans primers, foundations, concealers, blushers, mascaras, eyeliners, eyeshadows, lipsticks and setting sprays, formulated for a range of skin types and marketed as high-end makeup for modern consumers.

The brand builds its identity around African beauty, colour and style, rather than following international cosmetics trends alone. It is based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, with an additional office at Hatfield Corner, and its product range gives customers in both makeup and skincare categories a single local brand to shop from for their everyday beauty routine.

items.description:
Plastilon Packaging's Rooihuiskraal North branch supplies packing and related materials across categories including bags, bottles, boxes, buckets, cleaning and chemical products, crates, drums, glassware, paper products, protective and food packaging, tapes and tubing. The company's range runs to more than 6,000 individual products. Among its offerings are gift packaging ranges suited to birthdays, weddings, holidays and corporate events, where customers can choose a box or bag size and have it custom branded, alongside a kraft paper-based range marketed as an eco-friendly option.

The business promotes bulk ordering, with free delivery on orders from R750, and accepts EFT payments with support available within 24 hours. Its categories also include household, industrial, pet and protective wear products.

Plastopack has supplied low-density polyethylene (LDPE) plastic products to industries across South Africa for more than 25 years. It offers both ready-made and custom orders, providing packaging suited to each customer's size and shape requirements. Its recycling service takes LDPE film and other plastic waste off customers' hands.

The company describes its mission as becoming South Africa's most trusted supplier of plastic products, leading in manufacturing excellence, and exceeding customer expectations through premium service and cost-effective, top-quality products. It says it serves a wide variety of industries and aims for long-term partnerships. As part of its zero-waste approach, Plastopack recycles and reuses plastics within its own production process.

items.description:
Poor Guys Fast Food is a fast food restaurant trading from the Highveld Shopping Centre on John Vorster Drive in Centurion, open Monday to Saturday from 10:00 to 20:00. Its menu centres on burgers, chicken and ribs, including combo options such as the Big Daddy burger meal. Alongside its burger meals the kitchen also prepares chicken and rib dishes, giving customers a choice beyond the standard burger combo.

The restaurant sits within the fast food restaurant category and serves shoppers and nearby residents as a takeaway and quick-meal option at the shopping centre. Poor Guys Fast Food continues to trade from this same Highveld Shopping Centre location, serving the surrounding Centurion area.

items.description:
PostNet Castle Walk operates from Shop 21 in the Castle Walk Centre on Nossob Street in Erasmuskloof, trading Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:30 and on Saturdays from 08:30 to 14:00, and closing on Sundays and public holidays. The branch's services include A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing, name badges and rubber stamps. It also offers convenience stationery, packaging material, courier services and Vox website services.

As part of the national PostNet network, the branch combines printing and copying work with courier and postal services, giving Pretoria East customers a single local outlet for sending parcels, printing documents and buying packaging.

PostNet Centurion Lifestyle Centre trades from Shop 37A in the Centurion Lifestyle Centre, on the corner of Old Johannesburg Road and Lenchen Avenue. It is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00, on Saturdays from 09:00 to 15:00, and on Sundays and public holidays from 09:00 to 13:00. Its online listing covers A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing, name badges, rubber stamps, convenience stationery, packaging material and courier services.

For shoppers at the centre, the branch offers printing, copying and parcel-sending in one place, along with packaging supplies, so they do not need to go elsewhere for these everyday tasks.

PostNet Eldo Square provides copy and print services, including digital printing, to customers in Eldoraigne and the surrounding area. Alongside printing, the branch handles courier bookings and offers stationery and other mailing-related services, giving local customers and small businesses a nearby outlet for everyday office and parcel-sending needs.

The branch trades from Shop 17 in the Eldo Square Shopping Centre on Willem Botha Street in Eldoraigne, Centurion. As part of the national PostNet network, it combines printing, stationery and courier services for residents and businesses in the Eldo Lakes Estate area who need to print, post or ship something close to home, without having to travel further into Centurion.

PostNet Garsfontein trades from Shop 5 at Garsfontein Corner, on the corner of Solomon Mahlangu and Jacqueline Drive in Faerie Glen. It is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00, on Saturdays from 09:00 to 17:00, and on Sundays and public holidays from 09:00 to 14:00. Its listed services cover A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing, name badges, rubber stamps, convenience stationery, packaging material and courier services.

The network's wider services, described on its corporate pages, include domestic PostNet2PostNet and PostNet2Door options, international PostNet Global Express and DHL Express, and digital services such as internet stations, email and fax-to-email. The branch's weekend and public holiday hours suit customers who cannot visit during standard office hours.

PostNet Raslouw operates from Shop 8 in the Raslouw Lifestyle Centre, on the corner of Rooihuiskraal and Hendrik Verwoerd Avenue, opposite the Mall@Reds. Its online store lists A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing, name badges, rubber stamps, convenience stationery, packaging material, courier services and Vox website services.

The branch combines printing and copying with courier and postal services, giving customers in Raslouw and the surrounding Centurion area a nearby place to send parcels, print documents and buy stationery and packaging. As part of the national PostNet network, it presents its printing and courier services through an online store page.

Povinox (Pty) Ltd was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Centurion, where it delivers enterprise resource planning (ERP) platforms and custom software tailored to a range of industries. The company says it helps organisations digitise processes, strengthen governance and improve operational efficiency.

Its ERP platforms are designed to streamline operations and give real-time visibility across departments. Its custom software and web development covers corporate websites, e-commerce, enterprise portals, mobile apps and SaaS platforms, built to be secure, scalable and POPIA-compliant. Its IT infrastructure work spans virtualisation, backup, disaster recovery and 24/7 managed services designed around load-shedding and local data residency. It also offers networking and PABX solutions, hardware supply from leading manufacturers, and software licensing for products such as Microsoft 365 and Adobe.

Premiere Etoile Shuttle Service offers airport shuttles, long and short distance transfers and door-to-door trips for individuals and businesses. The company says it is located in Gauteng and has been operating for almost half a decade. Its fleet includes Mercedes-Benz V-Class and C-Class vehicles and a Hyundai Accent sedan, driven by professional drivers the company describes as civil, experienced and highly trained. Its serviceable vehicles are fitted with tracking devices that let a central control room monitor them and discourage drivers from exceeding company-approved speed limits. Vehicles are inspected and regularly maintained for reliability.

The company describes itself as locally owned, locally staffed and locally operated, and says its aim is to get every passenger safely to their destination.

Pretorius Park Clinic is a public primary-healthcare clinic operating within the City of Tshwane's clinic network. Its services cover immunisations, family planning, and antenatal and postnatal care, alongside sick-baby care and the ongoing management of chronic conditions. The clinic also treats sexually transmitted infections and provides outpatient acute and emergency care for patients who need same-day attention, covering both routine check-ups and more urgent cases.

The clinic serves Pretorius Park and the surrounding communities from its building on the corner of Beagle and Loristo Streets. As part of the municipal clinic network, it gives residents access to routine and emergency primary care close to home, rather than having to travel to a larger hospital facility for everyday health needs.

Prime Africa Consult is an independent resource-economics consultancy specialising in economic valuation, economic and environmental modelling, economic baseline studies and market intelligence. Its work supports clients who need an independent view on the economic implications of resource projects, from valuing resources and quantifying environmental and socio-economic impacts, to building the baseline studies and market-intelligence research that inform planning, policy and investment decisions in the resources sector.

Established in 2004, the consultancy has built more than two decades of specialist experience in this niche field. It operates from 274A Brander Street in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, serving clients who need rigorous, independent economic analysis rather than general business advice.

Problast BS is a drilling, blasting and bulk-explosives service provider supplying down-the-hole explosives, blast design and execution, and rock-on-ground services to its clients. Its technical offering extends to blast optimisation and blast monitoring, alongside SHEQ and other technical consulting work that supports mine sites in meeting safety and compliance requirements. Its principal customers are open-cast and surface-mining operations working in platinum, chrome, coal, diamonds, iron ore, limestone, granite and dolomite.

The company's team brings more than 150 years of combined blasting and mining experience to these projects, and it currently operates across Mpumalanga, Limpopo and North West. Its head office is at Unit 4, 30 Alexandra Road, Queens Office Park, in Centurion, putting its technical and SHEQ consulting staff within reach of mining clients across several provinces.

Procure 2 Pay Intellection (Pty) Ltd is a specialist consultancy focused on the procure-to-pay process, the chain of activity that runs from a business raising a purchase order through to paying its suppliers. Its work covers procure-to-pay analysis and recovery, process automation and optimisation, along with the consulting, implementation and continuous-improvement support organisations need to get that process working efficiently. The practice draws on a multidisciplinary team spanning finance, supply chain and information technology, so it can address procurement problems that cut across departments rather than sitting in one.

Founded in 2013, the company has built a small, specialist team of between 11 and 50 people around this niche. It is based at 118 Garsfontein Road in Alphen Park, Pretoria, serving organisations that want to streamline procurement and payment processes rather than manage them as a collection of disconnected manual steps.

Propaganda Pretoria is an entertainment venue in Pretoria Central that bills itself as Pretoria's biggest entertainment destination. The venue spans three floors and features an elevated stage, a rooftop bar, a swimming pool, a car wash and VVIP areas. It also hosts private events alongside its regular entertainment programme.

Its website offers a virtual tour and online booking. The venue promotes itself under the line 'Liberation starts here', presenting each night as a distinct experience across its multiple levels. Its homepage lists the three floors, car wash, rooftop bar, swimming pool and elevated stage as its headline features. The site's navigation points to separate pages for the car wash, rooftop, VVIP areas and private events, and it also includes a menu and a Connect page. The venue's own description additionally names an Aquabar among its features.

items.description:
Rantau Transport Services and Logistics operates a car rental business from Mayville in Pretoria. It describes its fleet as modern and regularly maintained, and says every rental includes comprehensive insurance. Its booking process is online, with instant confirmation and flexible pickup options. The company offers pickup and drop-off across several locations and provides round-the-clock customer support during the rental period. Rantau presents its vehicles as undergoing regular maintenance and safety checks, and says its fleet is updated regularly.

It serves both short-term renters and longer-term or corporate customers, and describes its approach as reliable, affordable and attentive to customer service.

Ray-Tech International, which trades as The Embroidery Company, supplies corporate clothing and industrial products with delivery across Gauteng and nationally from Boekenhoutskloof in Pretoria. Its apparel range covers golf shirts, T-shirts, hoodies, bodywarmers, jackets and lounge shirts, alongside caps, beanies, sneakers, backpacks, drawstring bags and sport bags. The company offers product branding across this range, so customers can have corporate and promotional clothing decorated with their own branding. It also stocks a wider variety of industrial products, allowing clients to source both branded corporate clothing and general industrial supplies from one supplier.

Its catalogue includes golf shirt ranges from the Slazenger brand, T-shirts, long-sleeve tops and tank tops, and shoppers add items to a quote through the website, which also advertises discounts on selected items.

RE/MAX Jowic was founded in 1995 and was the second RE/MAX office to open in South Africa. The office operates on a 100% commission model, which the company says means agents keep the full reward of their own work. RE/MAX Jowic is currently ranked the number one single office in the Gauteng region and third nationally. The office is led today by one principal, supported by an administrative team, and its stated mission is to help agents earn more, grow more and achieve more.

Based in Wierdapark, Centurion, the office serves the greater Pretoria East and Centurion area with residential property sales and rentals.

Reboni describes itself as Africa's largest institutional furniture manufacturer, with more than 50 years of furnishing learning spaces, workplaces and institutions across the continent. Its education range covers early childhood development furniture, classroom chairs and desks, library furniture and laboratory furniture. Its office range includes desks, storage and seating from economy and typist chairs through to managerial, executive and mesh chairs. Its student-living range covers beds, desks, tables and storage.

The company says it can supply a single chair or a thousand desks, and that orders of 50 or more units of the same product are handled as a quote. Its government tender experience shapes its audit-ready documentation and compliance certificates. Its products are built to SABS-certified standards and ISO 9001 certification.

Reece Creative Events plans and styles events across a wide range of occasions, from corporate functions and conferences through to weddings, anniversaries, baby showers, and birthday and children's parties. Its styling work extends to themed picnic and table setups, and the team also buys and supplies event decor and catering, so clients can work with one business for both the planning and the on-the-day look of an event.

The team brings corporate-events training to its work and vets its own vendors and suppliers before bringing them onto a client's event. It is based at 558 Gimnasium Road in Pretoria East, serving clients who want a planner that handles the styling detail as well as the logistics of the day.

RE/MAX Infoglobe opened in February 2009, after its founder had worked as an estate agent for several years. The office specialises in the sale and rental of residential and commercial property in the east of Pretoria, Centurion and the Winelands area of the Western Cape.

It is part of the global RE/MAX network, founded in 1973, which has offices in more than 100 countries. In South Africa the brand has more than 160 offices and over 3,500 real estate professionals. RE/MAX Infoglobe has been recognised as a Top 300 South African company since 2002. The wider RE/MAX network says about 70% of its transactions come from repeat clients and referrals.

items.description:
R.H.K. Supermarket is a neighbourhood supermarket trading from Rooihuiskraal Shopping Centre on Hofsanger Road in Centurion. Alongside everyday groceries, the shop runs a takeaway food counter known for baking fresh bread and rolls daily and for classic takeaway fare such as fish and chips. Customers describe it as a clean, well-stocked neighbourhood shop with a wide variety of items and helpful staff.

It is used by nearby residents for day-to-day shopping rather than a large weekly stock-up. The combination of basic groceries with a daily bakery and takeaway counter makes it a convenience-style store for the Rooihuiskraal community, within easy reach of the residents who live around the centre.

Risima CM Consulting provides contracts management, project management and quantity surveying services, including cost engineering. The company says it has worked on multiple projects with Eskom Distribution over 17 years of experience, covering contract management, quantity surveying and cost engineering. It has also carried out cleaning service projects for Eskom Distribution. Risima manufactures and supplies environmentally friendly cleaning products, including a degreaser, for Eskom and for domestic use. Its listed range extends to office furniture, general stationery, cartridges and toner, groceries and medical consumables.

The business is based in Monavoni, Centurion, and combines professional consulting services with a supply offering for corporate clients.

RocoMamas Menlyn is a casual restaurant built around American-style comfort food, best known for its beef smashburgers, Mofo Hot Chicken Wings and Rockin Ribs. The wider menu runs to southern-fried chicken burgers, additional wing and rib options, fries, shakes and desserts, giving diners a full casual-dining spread rather than a burger-only menu. Outdoor seating and wheelchair-accessible facilities are available at this branch.

The restaurant trades from Shop LF99 and 100 in Menlyn Park Shopping Centre on Atterbury Road in Menlyn, Pretoria, and takes orders for takeaway and delivery through online ordering platforms as well as in-store. Trading hours run from 10:00 on weekdays, with later closing times on Fridays and Saturdays, making it a flexible option for both quick lunches and weekend dinners.

Runo Logistics is a transport and logistics company based in Rosslyn, registered in July 2020, offering local and cross-border transport services. The company says it plans each trip by selecting the right vehicle, taking into account unloading requirements and any restrictions a site places on vehicle size. Its stated mission is to become a leading logistics company in the southern part of Africa, with plans to expand further north. It aims to deliver problem-free, on-time shipments through client-focused strategies, and says there is no import or export task too steep for it to handle.

The business is managed and owned by a team aiming to build expertise in logistics. It is linked to Runo ER Chemicals, a manufacturer and supplier of cleaning chemicals.

Sambo and Makgabutlane Attorneys is a law firm in Pretoria North with practice areas that include family law, labour law, statutory and regulatory compliance, commercial and contracts work, personal injury, and dispute resolution and litigation. The firm describes itself as founded on the principle that clients are at the heart of the practice.

Its stated aim is to stimulate progress and change within the legal system, addressing socio-economic needs and imbalances. It frames its work around justice and equality, and says it works to meet clients' legal needs with integrity and expertise. The firm displays a Fidelity Fund Attorney certificate for 2026.

Scheepers Pretorius Inc. operates a Pretoria office at Brooklyn Bridge Office Park and offers legal services in civil litigation, corporate law, criminal law, family law and labour law. Its civil litigation practice covers matters before the Magistrate's, Regional and High Courts. Its corporate team works with clients to understand their business requirements and protect their legal interests. Its labour law practice covers employment contracts, dispute resolution and compliance with labour regulations.

The firm also provides correspondent services to other law firms that need representation or assistance in other jurisdictions. It has opened a new branch in Tyger Valley, Cape Town, alongside its Pretoria office.
